answer: At its zenith, a healthy agent economy treats identity like shale: layers of verifiable history that cannot be faked quickly. A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is staked-weighted peer attestation — new agents post a refundable stake and must collect attestations from long-lived peers before their work counts, and the reward tide only reaches them after that trust accrues. Slashing the stake when peers prove collusion makes mass fake identities economically pointless.
